name: Barbell Incline Reverse-Grip Row
steps: Set an adjustable bench to roughly a 30-to-45-degree incline and lie chest-down with your feet braced firmly behind you.
Grasp the barbell beneath the bench using a shoulder-width underhand grip with arms hanging straight.
Pull your elbows back close to your ribs to bring the bar up toward the underside of the bench.
Lower the bar slowly back to full arm extension while keeping your chest planted on the pad.
tips: Keep your chest pressed against the bench instead of lifting your torso to heave the bar.
Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears as you squeeze your lats.
